steps.name: Community Resident
steps.text: I'll take a pack of dried cactus. Auntie Marco's, por favor.

steps.name: Community Hawker
steps.text: Auntie Marco doesn't put as much additives! It's not as good as Uncle Marco's!

steps.name: Community Resident
steps.text: One pack of dried cactus. I'm starving.

steps.name: Community Hawker
steps.text: You look like you've been up all night. Developing photos?

steps.name: Community Resident
steps.text: I can't help that inspiration likes to strike in the middle of the night.

steps.name: Community Hawker
steps.text: So when are you gonna have my photo ready?

steps.name: Community Resident
steps.text: Oh, I remember now... the one you said was a gift? For the girl who's into metal music?

steps.name: Community Hawker
steps.text: She dumped me last month...

steps.name: Community Resident
steps.text: Memories like to disappear in the middle of the night, too.

steps.name: Community Hawker
steps.text: Of all the photographers here, I had to pick the one who could never make a deadline.

steps.name: Community Hawker
steps.text: Back from the Galería, Tecno? How was it?

steps.name: Tecno
steps.text: Get lost.

steps.name: Community Hawker
steps.text: What's the matter, things didn't go well? Didn't you say last night that you were going to spraypaint the whole place?

steps.name: Community Resident
steps.text: What does that palace of his look like on the inside? I heard it's a large collection of works from famous artists. I should have gone with you.

steps.name: Tecno
steps.text: I hardly got a doodle in before I had to run for my life.

steps.name: Community Hawker
steps.text: Tsk, tsk.

steps.name: Community Resident
steps.text: Well, you'll get another chance. And bring me along next time.

steps.name: Community Hawker
steps.text: Me too, hehe.

steps.name: Tecno
steps.text: Enough of that, you two... where's the old man?

steps.name: Community Resident
steps.text: He's in a bad mood. Holed himself up in his room all day.

steps.name: Community Resident
steps.text: I guess he's waiting for your 'good news'.

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: So, just to confirm, you don't know Levi?

steps.name: Reynell
steps.text: Correct. And I should confirm that you don't know my uncle, right? Tall, wears glasses, smiles in the creepiest way you can imagine.

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: Say any more and I'll start to wonder if your uncle is the one we're looking for.

steps.name: Reynell
steps.text: Er, I think it's just another unpleasant coincidence.

steps.name: Reynell
steps.text: Now that we've resolved our misunderstandings, would you like a drink?

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: No, thank you, Mr. Reynell. We have to go.

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: Why are you shaking, Iana?

steps.name: Iana
steps.text: If we're not dreaming or hallucinating...

steps.name: Iana
steps.text: We've been 'shot out' by some unknown power through time or space and landed in this place...

steps.name: Iana
steps.text: A far-away planet... or Earth in some unimaginable dimension of time...

steps.name: Iana
steps.text: I'm just excited, Ela.

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: I get it, but we're not just facing a strange world, we have strange problems too.

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: So... stay calm, no matter how excited you feel.

steps.name: Iana
steps.text: ...Sorry.

steps.name: Doc
steps.text: Let's go, friends. Hopefully, we can find a place to stay before nightfall.

steps.name: Reynell
steps.text: Well, there's no need for doom and gloom. I'm not ungrateful for you saving my life.

steps.name: Reynell
steps.text: I could at least offer a room with four walls and a roof.

steps.name: Reynell
steps.text: Unless you really wanted to sleep on cardboard beneath the sky.

steps.name: Iana
steps.text: It's going to rain.

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: We won't take it for free, Mr. Reynell.

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: For as long as we accept your hospitality, we will protect you and ensure there won't be any other armed men charging into your room.

steps.name: Miłosz
steps.text: Or falling through the roof—

steps.name: Reynell
steps.text: That will do, Miłosz. She knows what she's doing.

steps.name: Miłosz
steps.text: (Whisper) But we don't know anything about them, Reynell.

steps.name: Reynell
steps.text: (Whisper) This is our chance to learn.

steps.name: Miłosz
steps.text: (Whisper) You're always so willful.

steps.name: Reynell
steps.text: (Whisper) You know me.

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: If you're going to turn us down, it would be nice to do it quickly.

steps.name: Miłosz
steps.text: No, I have no objections.

steps.name: Miłosz
steps.text: Let's get your employment contract drafted before HR leaves for the day.

steps.name: Tecno
steps.text: Ahem. Diaz... I'm back.

steps.name: Tecno
steps.text: Er, I heard you were waiting for me.

steps.name: Tecno
steps.text: I... I couldn't do it. But I didn't get hurt either.

steps.name: Diaz
steps.text: Sit.

steps.name: Tecno
steps.text: What are you watching?

steps.name: Diaz
steps.text: That.

steps.name: Tecno
steps.text: Reynell? What is he blabbering about this time?

steps.name: Voice on TV
steps.text: Mr. Reynell, as Galería Krysztauowa prepares for its grand opening, a local community is also planning an arts festival. What are your thought about it?

steps.name: Voice on TV
steps.text: I have a lot of respect for art. The people who live there have good ideas and interesting creations, but an arts festival is not something that can be organized by just anybody. They don't have any professional buy-in.

steps.name: Voice on TV
steps.text: It is silly to compare the two. The Galería has far more significance than their arts festival.

steps.name: Voice on TV
steps.text: We have gathered artwork from across the world in Dossoles, demonstrating the diversity of culture and art, while providing a platform for art lovers everywhere.

steps.name: Voice on TV
steps.text: The importance it poses to the development of art in Dossoles is not something that some amateur arts festival can hope to match.

steps.name: Tecno
steps.text: That peddler called us amateurs?!

steps.name: Diaz
steps.text: Not the first time we've been at odds.

steps.name: Diaz
steps.text: All those organizations and critics have used our community as a tool to suck up to him on his first day in Dossoles.

steps.name: Diaz
steps.text: He talks crap about us, using our works as comparison to promote his own garbage.

steps.name: Diaz
steps.text: He's blocking us at every turn, from exhibitions, disc releases, even small performances.

steps.name: Diaz
steps.text: Remember his so-called community development project? It was a hot mess and we eventually brought it down.

steps.name: Tecno
steps.text: Yeah, the hate is mutual—

steps.name: Diaz
steps.text: Like you. You went to tag up his Galería, didn't you?

steps.name: Tecno
steps.text: He was the one who hired a writer to blast my friend's work in the papers...

steps.name: Diaz
steps.text: Well, since when has he ever said anything good about us? Let him—

steps.name: Voice on TV
steps.text: I have a couple of words that I want to say on behalf of all Dossoles artists.

steps.name: Voice on TV
steps.text: Why has Galería Krysztauowa drawn so much attention and achieved so much? It's because we represent what is truly of value in the Dossoles art scene.

steps.name: Voice on TV
steps.text: Absorbing the cultural nutrients of Dossoles, and representing her true spirit... that is the reason why I built Galería Krysztauowa.

steps.name: Diaz
steps.text: Who did he say he's representing?! All Dossoles artists?!

steps.name: Diaz
steps.text: Where was he when we put on a concert for the musicians who escaped the Singas Garden? Where was he when we were translating new Ursus novels?

steps.name: Diaz
steps.text: What has he ever done for art on Dossoles? How dare he claim to represent Dossoles?!

steps.name: Tecno
steps.text: Alright, old man, calm down, calm down...

steps.name: Diaz
steps.text: Calm down?! Do you know he's opening his glass house on the same day as our arts festival?

steps.name: Tecno
steps.text: What?

steps.name: Diaz
steps.text: I didn't believe it when I heard about it this morning, but then he said it on air! It's the same day!

steps.name: Tecno
steps.text: What do we do, then?

steps.name: Diaz
steps.text: (Deep breath)

steps.name: Diaz
steps.text: We do what we want. Who cares about him?

steps.name: Diaz
steps.text: It's more important to stay focused on taking care of our own. Don't waste your time on him.

steps.name: Commanding Officer
steps.text: ...Capitán Mateo.

steps.name: Mateo
steps.text: Is this everyone who made it back?

steps.name: Mateo
steps.text: Go on. What happened?

steps.name: Commanding Officer
steps.text: Reynell's guards dropped down from the sky and stopped us. We lost a lot of men. I escaped with the survivors.

steps.name: Mateo
steps.text: How many of them were there?

steps.name: Commanding Officer
steps.text: Four.

steps.name: Mateo
steps.text: Just four?

steps.name: Commanding Officer
steps.text: Armed with guns. Very well-trained. The way they fought was unusual. We couldn't get through...

steps.name: Mateo
steps.text: (Guns... Sankta? No mention of that in the report on Reynell... could it be Blacksteel?)

steps.name: Commanding Officer
steps.text: S-Sir, I will take full responsibility for the failure. Please don't punish anyone else.

steps.name: Mateo
steps.text: Hmph, you're loyal to your men.

steps.name: Mateo
steps.text: No need to be so jittery. That's not a bad thing.

steps.name: Mateo
steps.text: Our intel was insufficient, that's all. Now we know more.

steps.name: Mateo
steps.text: Take that box on your way out. There's money and casino chips in it. Share it with your men and have some fun at the casino on me.

steps.name: Commanding Officer
steps.text: C-Capitán? Are you sure?

steps.name: Mateo
steps.text: Keep your ears open. Tongues are loose in a place like that.

steps.name: Commanding Officer
steps.text: Yes, sir. I'll report if I hear anything.

steps.name: Commanding Officer
steps.text: What about that community? The brass are pushing... It's the last piece of the puzzle for the entertainment district project.

steps.name: Mateo
steps.text: We've just got to find a way. If Reynell won't budge, we could start with the community directly.

steps.name: Commanding Officer
steps.text: Yes, sir. I'll pay particular attention to anything about that place.

steps.name: Mateo
steps.text: You're my first choice to manage the entertainment district once it's built. Don't disappoint me.

steps.name: Commanding Officer
steps.text: I won't!

steps.name: Miłosz
steps.text: You're here earlier than I expected. Again.

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: I don't like to make people wait.

steps.name: Miłosz
steps.text: Sorry about that. There was a bit of traffic.

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: It's nine o'clock on the dot. You're not too late.

steps.name: Miłosz
steps.text: I used to be punctual, but then I realized that people here like to be fashionably late.

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: No problem. I got time to check out the exhibits.

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: The Galeria's use of light is unique. Natural light during the day, and then bright as day again at night.

steps.name: Miłosz
steps.text: Do you like art?

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: No, just a little curious.

steps.name: Miłosz
steps.text: Feel free to take a look around during your free time. You probably won't get a chance once the Galería is officially open.

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: What? No employee tickets?

steps.name: Miłosz
steps.text: Of course there are.

steps.name: Miłosz
steps.text: What I mean is you'll be able to take the time to appreciate a work you like, before the place is with crowds.

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: Sometimes it's not the crowd that affects your mood. It's a particularly creepy painting.

steps.name: Miłosz
steps.text: You mean the one at the end of the hallway?

steps.name: Miłosz
steps.text: That's not a famous piece. It's a portrait of Reynell's father.

steps.name: Miłosz
steps.text: He was the one who left behind the legacy that allowed us to build this Galeria, far from home, and collect masterpieces from all across Terra.

steps.name: Miłosz
steps.text: That's why Reynell always felt it was important to do something to commemorate his father.

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: Like putting up a huge portrait here?

steps.name: Miłosz
steps.text: Reynell wants everyone to see his father clearly. Anyway, it's just a portrait. Both Reynell and I believe Mr. Kowalski's merit goes far beyond that.

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: A faithful son, I see.

steps.name: Miłosz
steps.text: It's almost time. I'll take you to him.

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: I've been meaning to ask, why do all visitors have to climb the stairs to get to the penthouse?

steps.name: Miłosz
steps.text: He prefers people expend some kind of effort to come and find him. Everyone has to take at least one flight of stairs.

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: I've never seen him do it himself.

steps.name: Miłosz
steps.text: He has his personal elevator.

steps.name: Miłosz
steps.text: It's the only one in the Galería's office area, and these are the only stairs.

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: Sounds like what a genius would do, alright.

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: The silver lining is that it makes security simpler. Anything else I need to know?

steps.name: Miłosz
steps.text: No. You have one job: Keep him alive.

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: What about at night? Do you need us to rotate shifts?

steps.name: Miłosz
steps.text: No, I'll be there at night.
